Feature: Login functionality for Doctor, Chemist, and Lab roles

Scenario Outline: Login with default password for a role
  Given the system has been set up with a default password for the <role> role
  When the user enters the username "<username>" and the password "<password>"
  Then the system should <result>

  Examples:
    | role   | username | password   | result                     |
    | Doctor | Doctor   | default    | log in successfully        |
    | Chemist| Chemist  | default    | log in successfully        |
    | Lab    | Lab      | default    | log in successfully        |
    | Doctor | Doctor   | wrong      | display an error message   |
    | Doctor | NonExistent | default | display an error message   |
